artist: Adriatique, Delhia de France, Marino Canal, Mind Against
thesis: Shape a restrained dark-to-warm journey where hypnotic blue geometry keeps the room in suspended tension until selective amber reunions express the idea of finding home.

artist_branding.summary: This collaboration sits in melodic-techno territory with Adriatique and Mind Against style traits: cinematic restraint, deep monochrome base states, long-form tension arcs, and emotionally timed warmth.
visual_cues: Afterlife-like low-saturation scenes with haze-first beam architecture
Long hypnotic sweeps and slow circular orbits rather than constant fast snaps
Selective amber or gold reveals as emotional punctuation, not constant palette
do_not_copy: Avoid directly recreating signature Afterlife set pieces, branded stage objects, or exact choreography from filmed headline shows.

motifs: Geometry motif: recurring center reunions after wide left-right drift to suggest return
Color motif: deep navy and steel blue world with rare amber home-call accents
Movement motif: 4- and 8-bar breathing sweeps that contract toward DSC on vocal resolve

visual_direction.color_story: Open in steel-blue and deep navy darkness, hold cool monochrome for most phrases, and deploy amber or dusty gold only for emotional resolution moments.
visual_direction.motion_story: Favor smooth 4-8 bar transitions with hypnotic circular travel during peaks and sparse single-source movement in breakdown valleys.
visual_direction.staging_story: Keep the back movers as atmospheric narrator, let PAR wash define the room shell, and use center/downstage convergences as the recurring home anchor.

must_include: Warm palette moments only when phrasing or vocal energy justifies emotional payoff
At least one long-form 8-bar atmospheric sweep in the breakdown arc
Phrase-aware technique selection with explicit contrast on phrase boundaries
avoid: Continuous full-rig strobe sections that flatten melodic phrasing
Rainbow cycling or saturated color changes every bar
Unmotivated random position jumps that break hypnotic continuity
